long_biography.plain_text:
Released by Legia Warsaw's reserves after a knee injury, Lewandowski rebuilt his career with Znicz Pruszków before reaching Poland's top flight at Lech Poznań. The Warsaw-born striker then moved to Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich, where his precision and movement made him one of European football's most prolific forwards. He later played for Barcelona before joining Chicago Fire and has captained Poland for much of his international career.

Professional contracts and endorsements underpin Lewandowski's wealth. He has also put earnings into ventures spanning property, hospitality and agricultural biotechnology, describing his approach as focused on the people behind an investment. Although these interests broaden his business profile, active football remains his defining occupation.
